faqs.question: What is Dread Disc?
faqs.answer: Dread Disc is a psychological horror / spot-the-difference / puzzle game by MadBug. You observe a changing apartment and must identify what has changed between visits, while keeping all doors and windows locked to survive.

faqs.question: Is there a Dread Disc demo?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo is available on both Steam and itch.io. The demo covers a portion of the apartment with the core spot-the-difference and door/window security mechanics.

faqs.question: When does Dread Disc release?
faqs.answer: Dread Disc is listed as 'Coming Soon' on Steam. No official release date has been announced yet. Follow the Steam page or the developer's itch.io page for updates.

faqs.question: Is Dread Disc free?
faqs.answer: The demo is completely free on both Steam and itch.io. The full game price has not been announced yet.

faqs.question: Is Dread Disc on Steam?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dread Disc has a Steam page and a free demo available for download. You can find it at store.steampowered.com/app/4156540/Dread_Disc/

faqs.question: Does Dread Disc have randomized elements?
faqs.answer: Yes. According to the developer, each playthrough has randomized elements. This means differences, object positions, and some events may vary between runs.

faqs.question: How long is the Dread Disc demo?
faqs.answer: The demo playtime varies depending on your observation speed, but most players report roughly 15–30 minutes for a single run. Multiple runs are recommended to experience different randomized variations.

faqs.question: What platforms is Dread Disc on?
faqs.answer: Dread Disc is currently available as a demo on Steam and itch.io for Windows PC. Full game platform availability has not been confirmed yet.

faqs.question: How many endings does Dread Disc have?
faqs.answer: The exact number of endings has not been officially confirmed. The demo appears to have multiple possible outcomes based on player choices. Full game endings will be documented after release.

faqs.question: Who developed Dread Disc?
faqs.answer: Dread Disc is developed by MadBug, an independent game developer. You can find their other work on itch.io at madbug.itch.io.

faqs.question: Does Dread Disc have randomized elements?
faqs.answer: Yes. The developer has confirmed that each playthrough has randomized elements. This means the specific differences, object positions, and some events may vary between runs. You cannot memorize a fixed set of changes — careful observation is required each cycle.
